title: OpenAI o3
before: o1 reasoned in a closed loop with no access to anything outside itself.
problem: Reasoning without tools cannot look anything up or run code to check itself.
breakthrough: A reasoning model that calls tools, including search and code execution, inside its chain of thought.
why: Reasoning and tool use merged here, which is the technical basis of the agentic models that followed.
next: Folded into GPT-5's unified system later that year.
inherits: Tool calls inside the reasoning loop.
